title.zh: Robinhood 股票代币交易量达150亿美元，Morpho 支持其作为稳定币贷款抵押品
title.en: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days

current_state.zh: Morpho已推出支持将Robinhood股票代币作为稳定币贷款抵押品，Robinhood Chain提供代币化基础设施，第三方应用可接入这些借贷市场。
current_state.en: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.

updates.title_zh: Robinhood 报告股票代币交易额达 150 亿美元，其公链已运行满 100 天
updates.title_en: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days
updates.what_changed_zh:
Robinhood 表示，其股票代币（Stock Tokens）累计交易额已突破 150 亿美元，持有者数量达到 20 万，同时其公链运行已满 100 天。Morpho 的仪表盘显示，该网络上的存款规模约为 11 亿美元。

这是目前代币化股票领域披露的规模最大的量化里程碑之一，而 Morpho 的存款数据表明 Robinhood 链上已经承载了第三方 DeFi 借贷活动。

Robinhood 的股票代币是由 Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited 发行的代币化债务证券，仅提供对标的证券的经济敞口，不赋予投资者对标的发行公司的法定权利或受益权；目前可交易品种超过 190 个，涵盖与 NVIDIA、Google、Apple 和 Invesco QQQ 挂钩的代币。约 11 亿美元的存款数据来自 Morpho 自身的仪表盘，而非 Robinhood 公布。
updates.what_changed_en: Robinhood says its stock tokens have crossed $15 billion in cumulative trading volume with 200,000 holders as its chain passes 100 days, while Morpho's dashboard shows about $1.1 billion deposited on the network.

updates.background_zh: Robinhood 依据 MiFID II 在欧洲以衍生品形式提供 Classic Stock Tokens，标的资产由一家美国持牌机构托管。Morpho 是构建在以太坊上的借贷协议，采用隔离金库模式，与 Aave 形成竞争。
updates.background_en: Robinhood offers its Classic Stock Tokens in the EU under MiFID II as derivatives, with the underlying assets held by a US-licensed institution. Morpho is a lending protocol built on Ethereum that competes with Aave and uses a model of segregated vaults.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息显示代币化传统资产与链上信贷之间的联系正在加强：在 Robinhood 链上交易的股票代币，与同一网络内 Morpho 金库的存款相结合，将股票敞口与 DeFi 借贷及抵押品流动连接起来。这使得代币化股票交易场所及为其提供服务的借贷协议成为观察链上流动性与市场结构变化的重点板块。
updates.market_impact_en: The disclosure points to a growing link between tokenized traditional assets and on-chain credit: stock tokens traded on the Robinhood chain, combined with deposits into Morpho vaults on the same network, tie equity exposure to DeFi lending and collateral flows. That makes tokenized-equity venues and the lending protocols serving them a segment to watch for shifts in on-chain liquidity and market structure.

updates.title_zh: 【Morpho 支持以 Robinhood 股票代币为抵押品借入稳定币】
updates.title_en: 【Morpho 支持以 Robinhood 股票代币为抵押品借入稳定币】
updates.what_changed_zh:
10 月 22 日，借贷协议 Morpho 宣布 Robinhood 股票代币已在其平台上线，用户可将股票代币作为抵押品借入稳定币。Morpho 提供底层信贷网络，Robinhood Crypto 旗下的 Robinhood Chain 提供代币化基础设施，任何应用均可接入面向股票代币的借贷市场。

该集成把链上信贷市场的抵押品范围扩展到代币化股票，超出了 DeFi 借贷通常接受的加密原生资产范畴。

Morpho 在其中的角色是信贷层而非代币化层，股票代币的发行与结算由 Robinhood Chain 承担。公告未披露具体支持哪些股票、抵押率，以及已有哪些应用完成接入。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.
updates.background_zh: Morpho 是 2021 年推出的开源 DeFi 借贷网络，运行于以太坊及其他 EVM 兼容链上，允许开发者基于其基础设施构建定制化借贷市场。Robinhood Chain 是 Robinhood 基于 Arbitrum 技术构建的以太坊 Layer 2，面向代币化现实世界资产，初期聚焦美国股票与 ETF 敞口，通过追踪股价、可全天候交易的 ERC-20 股票代币实现。
updates.background_en: Morpho is an open-source DeFi lending network launched in 2021 that runs on Ethereum and other EVM-compatible chains, letting developers build customized lending markets on its infrastructure. Robinhood Chain is Robinhood's Arbitrum-based Ethereum Layer 2 aimed at tokenized real-world assets, with an initial focus on US equity and ETF exposure through ERC-20 stock tokens that track share prices and trade around the clock.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一举措把 DeFi 信贷流动性与股票市场定价连接起来：Morpho 市场上的稳定币借款需求部分取决于代币化股票抵押品，而股票代币的全天候交易与价格源将成为这些市场清算与风险管理的输入。风险敞口主要集中在 Morpho 的借贷池、稳定币借款方以及 Robinhood Chain 生态。
updates.market_impact_en: The move links DeFi credit liquidity to equity-market pricing: demand for stablecoin borrowing inside Morpho markets now depends partly on tokenized-stock collateral, while the stock tokens' 24/7 trading and price feeds become inputs to liquidation and risk management for those markets. Exposure concentrates in Morpho's lending pools, stablecoin borrowers, and the Robinhood Chain ecosystem.
